sense.text:
Why has there always been a schism between blacks and whites, as long as anybody has been alive, your grandmother and hers? Black people dance for them, shuffle their feet, dunk a basketball, bleach their skin in Jamaica, put the blonde in their hair, take on their lying gods and their politics, and still are not accepted. Only that drug called Christianity can make you keep trying. The pastor says God so loved the world, God loves everybody, Chinese, Indian, Arab, sinner or sinless, come as you are. That is so far from the truth. The answer to why they hate us so much is a biblical one.

“Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?” The heathen here are the other nations, starting with Esau, Edom, the Caucasian. Look at the level of hatred in their spirit. Us, and black means Hispanic too, we don't go out on the road to beat a white woman; Esau doesn't care. A man six foot four will punch a sister four foot five dead in the face. It is a disdain deep-seated in their DNA.

So don't get fooled by the old white man and his wife, Mr. Thompson and Mildred, smiling and making apple pie. They were there back in the 50s screaming at us. When the old white woman on the plane asked for her bag to be lifted, the answer was no: she was there, she was not fighting for our liberation, and even if she took no part herself she received the benefits of it. They are complicit.

“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed”. The nations, beginning with Esau, because the earth is given into the hand of the wicked, sit down in a counsel to be in opposition. Against who? The Lord and his anointed. And who is the anointed of the Lord? We are: God's chosen, made in his express image. So whoever rages with that disdain against the Lord's chosen is not the Lord's chosen.

They take a crafty counsel and they kill us. Twelve or thirteen correction officers beat a brother to death in handcuffs in a hospital, on video, and the DA filed no charges. Maybe he was a criminal; it still took twelve of them to beat a handcuffed man to death. Why do the heathen rage? Because that man is one of God's anointed, a child of God. He was in sin, but he could be taught, he could repent, and they killed him.

They galvanize to kill us and we don't galvanize behind it. The black leaders with big platforms say nothing and will not give the Bishops and the Deacons a place to speak, because they worry about their money. We are not looking for them; we are looking for the kids in the streets, who will be raised up as warriors for God. The Bishops and Deacons on the front lines doing the work are the superheroes God sent back.
“Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.” That is the counsel they took: break the bands that hold Israel together and keep us separated.
“He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.” Then he speaks to them in his wrath and in “his sore displeasure.” Their counsel is nothing to him.

“Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.” “I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.” Even with all that we are, truck drivers, working in the supermarket, two-bit jobs, driving Uber, delivering food, God still says: you are my son.

The Lord is raising up a new generation of honorable men to serve him according to the Bible. Not belligerent men beating women, not men taking multiple wives with no job, not liars, homosexuals and adulterers who smear and slander in the name of Israel; that is the false image painted of the Israelite man. There is no wiggle room in the laws. Get yourself right or beat your feet, because the young men coming up need to see how real men move so we can take this thing back.

“Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.” So pray it: Father, I repent of my sins, I ask for mercy for me and for the nation of Israel; bring them under the foot. The churches don't teach this. And it is not just Old Testament; the New Testament says the same.

After that one verse it makes sense why the heathen rage. It makes sense why they painted their image in the book and made everybody white, and why they called Puerto Ricans, Mexicans, Dominicans, blacks and Haitians every other name: because they know that if we understand we are the sons of God, we will ask, and God will give us the heathen for an inheritance. Tell that to a black Christian and he asks, what about the other people, what about the white man? God said, I called you my son; ask of me.

That is why they broke the bond. It is a perpetual hatred. Remember the faces: Jamar Clark, George Floyd, Philando Castile, Stephon Clark, Michael Brown, Breonna Taylor, and the little children, and that is only a snippet of the last twenty years. And then they want you to read John 3, for God so loved the world.

precepts.why:
“Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.” The bands they said to break asunder are these: the brotherhood between the northern kingdom and the southern kingdom.

Once the band was broken, that is why we became black and Hispanics, Jamaicans, Americans, Haitians and all these other things. That was the counsel they took: we have to separate them, we got to keep them separated. And that is why, even today, they can beat one of us to death in handcuffs and it is not a big deal for more than a day.

“All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes”. The world was made for Israel's sake, and they understood it. That is why the heathen rage: if we ask of God, he will give them to us for an inheritance.

Watch how they went to war against the heathens: swords out, people dying, gold and precious metals and people to steal, and in all that bloodshed, secure the book. Go find the book, the way they went after the Ark of the Covenant. Burn all the other books, keep this one, and draw a picture in it. Why, if the book doesn't matter? Because they believe in the power in the book, and they understand the connection it makes us with God.

So since they could not get rid of every book, they changed what you think of the book. They made you think the book is for everybody and that you ain't nobody; serve me right and you get all the watermelon in the kingdom. That is why Christianity is such a drug. There is no better pimp than the white man: he has you believing in a book that is about you, that tells you Christ is black, and you read it and say he isn't. They believe the power of this book.

sense.text:
“Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king”. This Herod is Herod the Great, an Edomite. His father Antipater was a politician who raised him up to follow in his footsteps; the Herodians were that family line. The Apocrypha ends, and Matthew begins with Herod the Great.

Herod married into the Hasmonean house. Mariamne, a Hasmonean princess, he killed, and her children with her; Doris and her son he killed too, to make sure he solidified his place as leader. Rome did not care as long as it got its tribute. He positioned himself, the snake he is. Esau, Edom, Amalek and Rome are the same spirit, joined together.

“There came wise men from the east to Jerusalem”. There was already a problem: we were scattered all over the place, and someone was coming back.

“Where is he that is born King of the Jews?” Herod is already king over the Jews. He took down the Hasmonean dynasty and has the backing of Rome, the superpower on the earth. Why would some baby being born, called King of the Jews, be a threat to him? Yet “he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.”

Why would Jerusalem be troubled, when for us the coming of the King is good news? It was the ones in position. To this day there are people among our own who will sell this mission out for money, sit down with CNN and demean it, just as there was Jason, that ungodly wretch, in the time of the Maccabees. Herod knew who he had in his pocket. And he was troubled because he believed that Bible. Don't think they don't know we are the Jews; it is our own people who don't know, and our job is to make them know.

Herod gathered “all the chief priests and scribes of the people together” and demanded where Christ should be born, and they told him: “In Bethlehem of Judea”, for “out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.” They told Herod the King was coming to rule, and Herod is ruling; there cannot be two. If the book were a fairy tale he would not have cared. It troubled his mind.

The same is happening today. Wars and rumours of wars, half of America on fire, tsunamis, the Middle East unstable, and the people starting to repent and keep the commandments. It is troubling them. So we have to walk upright out in the world, because people are watching. They looked to King, to Malcolm, to the big preachers and the podcasts in the barber chair; they were not the guys. The ones on the front line are, and that is what worries them.

Herod “privily called the wise men” and said “Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.” That is the psychosis of the man. Herod was a mass murderer; why didn't he say, let me know so I can kill him? Because Esau talks with a forked tongue: words smooth as butter, war in his heart. He wanted to kill the baby of a prophecy because he believed it.

“Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt”. Why? “For Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.” This Edomite was out to kill that child to stop the prophecy from coming to pass, to stop the King of Kings, the new Governor, from being established.

They will do this in the last days. That is plainly why they hate us: they know we are coming back together under one common bond. They will try to infiltrate us and get some of us to sin and sell each other out; they will bring women, drugs and money. Don't be the one it goes through. Don't be that Judas Iscariot. Go ahead and sell out God's children and see how it works out for you.
He “departed into Egypt: And was there until the death of Herod”, Herod the Great, and his son took his place. “Out of Egypt have I called my son.”

Herod “was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under”. Not one baby. All of Bethlehem and all the coasts thereof, not a city block but a whole region of land, house to house, baby after baby, every male child two years and under. A sadistic, demonic, diabolical man.

Who was Herod? An Idumean, an Edomite, a Caucasian. Why can't we say that? And he did it because they believe what these words say. Today our footprint on the internet is so large it is impossible to deny us, so watch for them to send people in purple to commit crimes and say we did it. They are kicking against the pricks; the people that believe will not fall for it.

“In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.” Thousands and thousands of mothers and fathers crying, house after house. They are not: they are dead, and you can't comfort that. This damn Edomite is a killing machine, and they call us the murderers. We have some lunatics and hateful people, but nothing on this level; and the drive-by did not start with us, it was the white boy with the Tommy gun in Chicago.

So if they come in and kill your baby, who is that person to you? Your enemy. Not the sweet Christian line that God doesn't hate the sinner, he just hates the sin. They shoot a man in his own house eating ice cream in his boxers, and the judge hugs the killer and gives her a Bible, and black people hug her too. That is your enemy.

precepts.why:
“Then came up John from Gazera, and told Simon his father”. Simon is one of the brothers of Judas Maccabeus, and their family is the Hasmonean dynasty. His son is John Hyrcanus.

John Hyrcanus subdued all of Idumea and forcibly converted its people to what is called Judaism today. That is where you get the Jewish people from. The Hasmoneans were Israelites, but over time they began to wane from the laws and brought the Idumeans into the political party, while they paid tribute to Rome.

From that came Antipater, the father of Herod the Great. So the Herod in whose days Christ was born was an Edomite who had been brought in among us.

sense.text:
“There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea”: Herod the Great again. His wives were Doris, Mariamne, Mariamne the second, Cleopatra (not the Cleopatra you are thinking of) and Malthace. Mariamne the first was a Hasmonean princess; by that time we were slipping and starting to marry them. He killed her and his children by her so they could never take back the throne for that family, and he killed Doris and her son Antipater too. He married her to give himself esteem, as if he were part of the people.

If he would kill his own children and his own wives, what makes you think he cares about us? And he killed them because some of their blood was of these people. That is why our women with these white men, and our men with these white women, are crazy: you don't love your own.
Zacharias and Elisabeth “were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.” They were keeping the commandments.

“And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost”. That is the only way to be filled with the Holy Ghost: keep the commandments. You cannot be eating pork, shrimp and clams, be a murderer or adulterer, celebrate Christmas, Mother's Day and birthdays, think all nations can be saved, or believe Christ has no color or is white, and say you are filled with the Holy Spirit. The spirit is the word of God, and you have to be doing what it says.

“Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people”. His people. If John 3:16 meant what the church says, the Holy Spirit would have stopped Zacharias right there: what do you mean, his people?

He “hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David”, not for everyone, “As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began”. From the beginning of time it has always been about the Israelites. How did it become about everybody? The man you thought would teach you the Bible is the same man who enslaved you so you couldn't read for 400 years. And there are black devils too, not only white ones.

“That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us”. The Holy Spirit was on him to say that. In that time the enemies ruling over us were the Idumeans, Herod and the Romans, the same Herod who had just killed a whole coastline of babies.

The brother beaten to death in that hospital: are you praying for those men on Sunday? Some will say, I'm praying for all parties. No: God, destroy them, punish them, let the punishment hit for generations of their families.

“To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant; The oath which he sware to our father Abraham, That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear”. God swore an oath to Abraham that we would be delivered. When he said that in Abraham all nations would be blessed, it is because we were scattered into all nations; scripture after scripture explains it.

The young generation is not going for that old-time religion. A couple of generations ago our foreparents tried to assimilate; under segregation we were thriving by ourselves, and then the media programmed us to mimic what they called beauty. Learning the Bible has reignited us to understand that we are not like them, that we are different and should be proud of it. Nobody can make me feel bad about wearing fringes.

precepts.why:
“And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you”. We understand who is reigning over us, and the Bible says they hate you.

So the enemies Zacharias said we would be saved from are those that hate us, and those that hate us are the ones ruling over us. How do you remix that into something else? It is impossible.

sense.text: “At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus”. This is Herod Antipas, a son of Herod the Great. A tetrarch is a governor over the land. His brother Archelaus was over a nation of people. After Herod the Great died the Romans would no longer give his sons the title of king; they had governorship over different parts of their father's kingdom. Even Herod the Great, called a king, was a vassal king: a king in name, answering to Rome.

He said “This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead”, for Herod had laid hold on John and put him in prison “for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.” Antipas took his brother's wife, and she was really his niece. The people were ratchet.

“For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.” Why would John tell Herod it was unlawful? Not only because she was near of kin, or because it was adultery. The point is this: Herod was king of the Jews, so he understood the laws.

The Herods were raised up in the laws. John Hyrcanus conquered the whole of Edom and forced its inhabitants to convert, and from then they became a section of the Jewish people; Josephus gives that history. They were forced to keep the laws of God, and after a time they grew up in them, not that they were righteous, but they understood. Herod the Great built back the temple. So John was telling him: you know the laws, you know it is unlawful to marry your brother's wife.

precepts.why:
“There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.” When we came out of Egypt, the strangers, the other nations living among us, had to be conversant in all the laws.

Just as in Exodus 20 neither the manservant nor the maidservant nor the stranger was to work on the sabbath, strangers among us had to be circumcised and keep the law while they were with us. So a heathen living among Israel came up knowing the law of God, and that is how the Herods knew it.

“Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas”, Simeon, Lucius of Cyrene, “and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.” Paul and these men came up together with Herod, learning the doctrine of the law. Herod knew the laws.

That is why John said to him, you know it is unlawful for you to marry your brother's wife. Bad enough you married your niece.

And if the Bible is a book of fairy tales that means nothing, why would you be raised up learning the laws of the people? Our people, as soon as you teach them, look somewhere else: what about these other people? Esau is not doing that. They are not looking out for us.

Paul says “I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel”. Saul, who came up with Herod the tetrarch, came up at the feet of Gamaliel.

Gamaliel was “a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people”. He told the council, “Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men”, for Theudas and Judas of Galilee rose up and came to nought. “Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.”

Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, understood this was God's doing. Read Acts 13:1 again with that: we can safely say Herod came up under these doctors of the law, who spoke of the coming of the Messiah. That is why Herod the Great said, where's that baby at? Go find him and let me know so I can worship him. They understood the truth.

Esau believes it today. If we were nothing they would put us on the news and mock us. The big pastors, the black ones and the white ones, Joel Osteen, Jimmy Swaggart, do not want to sit down with Bishop Nathanyel, who is everywhere on the internet, because they would be embarrassed. That is how you know they know the Bible is for real. God put it in the spirit to make the internet, and now there are too many of us who know who we are and teach the word. You can't stop this.

sense.text: “King Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:)” and said John the Baptist was risen from the dead. Others said “it is Elias”, or a prophet. But Herod said, “It is John, whom I beheaded”.
Herod had bound John in prison “for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.” “For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.”

Herodias wanted him killed, but she could not, “For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy”. Why would the king fear John? To know he was a just man, he would have to know the laws to know what just is. In other words, if I do something to him, God might do something to me. So you know there is a God, Herod. Most of the world doesn't know the Bible, but the ones that know there is a God know that we are his children.

Because of their fear of losing everything, they act; it was the same with Pilate, who did not want to do anything to Christ but had his hand forced. When we live like sinners they don't worry about us. When we start keeping his commandments, we start changing the minds of the people, and that is the danger to them. And Herod “observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.”

On his birthday Herod made a supper “to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee”, and the daughter of Herodias danced, and the king said “Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.” She asked for John's head. A treacherous woman.

“And the king was exceeding sorry”. Why? Because he believed. He feared John, but pride took him: he was a big shot, and “for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.” He knew there were repercussions. There are repercussions for putting your hand on the children of God. They will kill us and lock us up anyway, but don't think you will escape paying for it.

“And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison”. The people knew John was a just man; they asked, what did he do that for?

That will happen in the last days. They will kill us out here, and the community will say, wasn't that the guy at the community cleanup, helping with the youth violence, raising the kids right? Weren't those the sisters teaching the young daughters how to be godly women? Not just reading the word of God, living it. Killing us will bring the people in: they will repent when they see it, no matter what the media says, because they saw us in the hood. The church folk sit in the churches; we are on the front lines in the ghetto.

Christ “went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God”. For the brothers teaching in the streets: ask trigger questions. Would you like to never have to work and never worry about your bills? To walk out of your house, sister, and know nobody is going to rape you, rob you or carjack you? To see your kids walk outside with no gunshots? To drive and not be afraid when you see a white police? They will keep saying yes; then show them how. That is fishing them in with the glad tidings: the kingdom of heaven is coming to you.
“Certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils”. She was healed.

“And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.” The steward in Herod's own house: people working for Herod were repenting. You think he didn't see that? Susanna was right there, and now she has a head cover and is not eating pork.

There will be credible people among us, regular people holding jobs. Other camps will pull in brothers who still have the old mind, who want to rob and steal and stay drunk and commit adultery and don't want to reform; repentance is for them too, but those camps hit a ceiling. We are looking for people who want to change their lives. One day you will see somebody in the White House with fringes on, somebody in the mayor's office with a head covering, somebody in the FBI tucking their fringes in their suit. We are going to be everywhere.

“Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea”. Before that, Herod's son Archelaus governed Judea, but only for about three years; he was a bad administrator for Rome, so Rome ruled him out of the way, made Judea a Roman province and put Pontius Pilate there, a Roman, not from Idumea.

“And Herod being tetrarch of Galilee”: that is the other son, Antipas. “And his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene”. The word tetrarch means governor: they were governors over these lands.
They led him to Pilate and accused him: “We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.”

Pilate said, “I find no fault in this man”, “And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.” Jews, our own people, sold out Christ, and it will happen again. Why would they sell him out, when his purpose was to usher in the King of Kings and establish back the kingdom?

When Pilate knew “he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod”, Antipas, the same Herod. “And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season”, because he had heard of his fame: this is the man my father wanted to kill. “He hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.” He was a groupie.
Herod “questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing. And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.”

“And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.” What is the purpose of men of war? They beat him, and after they beat him they dressed him up and sent him back.

“And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.” They were not close, because Pilate had taken over Jerusalem after Herod's brother lost it. But against the Jews they became confederate, one people. So shall all nations become one people against us; they cannot afford us raising up.

Pilate said, “Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people”. The perverting of the people was turning their minds back from what they were doing to the laws of God, and those Jews fought against us for it.

“Nothing worthy of death is done unto him. I will therefore chastise him, and release him.” Pilate found nothing wrong with Christ, no law broken, and still beat him. That is the perpetual hatred in their spirit toward us.

precepts.why:
Why would they sell Christ out? Because he was taking away their livelihood, their welfare. “Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.”

That was their worry: we are set up all right in this Roman kingdom; we have to get rid of this guy. In the last days there will be some of us who are well off, who have the riches they want and don't want to lose their place, and they will sell the whole nation out.

This generation of rappers has done it. Before, you could not co-sign homosexuality in rap; it was a death sentence, and in the black community it was a cardinal sin even when we were evil as hell. Today the top rappers say there's nothing wrong with it. They will talk about murdering each other and murdering your grandmother, but for money they will not call homosexuality wrong.

sense.text: “For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually”. Edom's anger tears perpetually: never ending, it never stops. Since when? Since the beginning, from Jacob and Esau in the womb.

precepts.why:
Isaac intreated the Lord for Rebekah, “and the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus?” If I am to have these children, why this struggle inside me?

“And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb”. Two children now, but two nations of people would come from them. “And two manner of people”: two different mannerisms, their ways are different. How many of us take a steak and eat it raw and kiss the dog on the mouth? That is not our nature, though some black people want to be white.

“Shall be separated from thy bowels.” When they come out they will be separated; they are never going to get along, and they are not meant to. That is why there is a war between black and white: God said from the beginning it was going to be like that. And that is the perpetual anger of Edom in Amos. They think they are winning.

sense.text:
“Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.” Rehearse means to train, drill, coach, instruct, inculcate: drill it into the ears of Joshua. Joshua, remember this: God is going to destroy Amalek, which is Esau. He told Joshua so Joshua could tell the people.

Forget sweet Jesus and the white man holding hands with us. They are not going to receive the kingdom or have any part in it. They are going to be slaves, they are going to serve, and after that they are going to be utterly destroyed. For some reason we keep trying to save everybody, so it has to be drilled in: Christ is black, Christ is black, Christ is black.

So why do the heathen rage? Hearing that they are to be utterly destroyed, anyone in Esau's place would rage.

precepts.why:
“The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart”. Like an iron pen in their head: something etched into your mind. That is what rehearse means; you rehearse it over and over again until it is graven there.

And what has to be graven is this: no what-about. They are not going to make it. God said they are going to be utterly destroyed.

Who is Amalek? “These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau”, and among them “duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom”.

Amalek is a duke of Esau, in the land of Edom. So the remembrance God will utterly put out from under heaven is Esau's.

sense.text:
“Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”, “Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.” Didn't he say he would utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek? Mount Seir is Esau. Edom is the nation of the descendants of Esau, and the country was also called Seir, Mount Seir.

That is why he told Joshua to rehearse it: he is going to utterly destroy you. Whatever you want to call yourself, Amalek, Edom, you are going to fall, you will not stand forever, and you are going to pay for the sins you have done against the children of Israel.
“I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.”

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: the same thing read in Amos 1. An ongoing hatred from the beginning, from birth, when we were in our mother's womb. It's okay; that is his job, he was built to hate. And he “hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity”.

“I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” He did not hate killing us, and he has not stopped. The names of the people he has killed are only a snippet; it is not close to the atrocities and the genocide he has committed. He is death, and hell follows him.

“Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth. And I will fill his mountains with his slain men”. You slew my people; I will fill your mountains with your slain men.

“I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. Perpetually desolate: he will utterly put out their remembrance, and they will never raise up again.

Now imagine Esau, who stole all the records and had sellouts explain the prophecies to him the way the chief priests did for Herod, learning that by these prophecies he is to be utterly destroyed and that God does not count him as his people. He knows the history: Israel redeemed out of Egypt, coming into Canaan, subduing the nations, passing by Esau on the way up. So there is a concerted effort: wherever we are on the earth, Russia, America, South Africa, we are at the bottom. They carved up Africa and left no highways through it. They take a crafty counsel to destroy us, and they think God's hand is against us forever. They are at ease.

precepts.why: “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” So who was in Mount Seir? Amalek, Esau, Edom, Bozrah: they are all the same people. When God says he is against Mount Seir and will make it most desolate, he is saying he will utterly destroy Esau.

sense.text: “Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.” There is a God they will have to answer to for what they have done.

“And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.” God was a little displeased with Israel, but the heathen helped forward the affliction: they raped our women and our children, gave us all type of diseases, murdered us. God said, I wanted to punish you, Israel, but you, Esau, went too far. I gave you power, and you thought you would get away with it.

They became at ease in killing us. They became prideful, and so they went too far. For them, the best they can do is help push this truth, and maybe the Lord will show them mercy in that day and they will get a good master.

“Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman?” “For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.” They really thought they were doing something.
“For I have sworn by myself, saith the Lord, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.”

“An ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle. For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen”. The nations are going to gather together against Edom. This is the war.

“Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.” Their terribleness is the murder they have committed, the atrocities, and it has deceived them. The average one really believes he has one up on us. But the ones in power understand: we have to keep these people separated from God; don't let them come back to God.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” “The Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.” That is how we know Idumea, Bozrah, Edom, Caucasian, Mount Seir, all the names you want to give them, are the same people.

“For it is the day of the Lord’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.” Because they helped forward the affliction of God's children. The time is going to come, and the time is at hand.

“Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” “Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” Small in the eyes of the other nations: he is going to turn them against Edom.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”, the same thing read in Jeremiah 49. “Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” These are signs given so we can identify who these people are: the caveman, the one who dwelt in the clefts of the rock.

“Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.” Setting his nest among the stars: the space travel. To identify him as the one God will bring down, we have to be able to reveal him so the people understand who the prophecy is talking about. So we can understand why he is upset.
The salutation: “We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren”, glorying in them “for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure”.
“That ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer”.
“Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you”. It is a righteous thing with God to pay back those that trouble us.

“When the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord”.
“When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe”. Remember that: those who will admire him in that day.
“Thine Almighty word leaped down from heaven out of thy royal throne, as a fierce man of war into the midst of a land of destruction”. The Almighty Word is Christ.
“And brought thine unfeigned commandment as a sharp sword, and standing up filled all things with death; and it touched the heaven, but it stood upon the earth.” He fills this whole earth with death.

precepts.why: “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.” The Almighty Word that leaped down from heaven out of the royal throne is Christ.

“And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us”. The Word that leaped down from heaven came down and dwelt among us: Christ, the Word made flesh, is the fierce man of war who comes down into the midst of a land of destruction.

“For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.” That is the unfeigned commandment brought as a sharp sword.

sense.text: “I dreamed a dream by night: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea”, “and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.” That man is Christ, and the thousands of heaven are his angels.
“And whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice”.
“There was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”. The four winds are armies.

“He had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.” And all they gathered to subdue him “were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.” All these nations will come together, and even though they are afraid they will fight, because they have nothing else to lose. And those of our people found joined to the enemy: that is the day of your death. Join with them and fight against the Lord and see what you get.

“He neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.” It fell on the multitude “and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke”.

Imagine Herod and the rest of them hearing the prophecy Ezra saw: wait a second, we have a problem.
“Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call unto him another peaceable Multitude.” After all that destruction, he calls the peaceable multitude.

Ezra awoke and asked the interpretation: “woe unto them that shall be left in those days and much more woe unto them that are not left behind!” This is the last days. If Herod understood it, and if in the time of the Maccabees they understood to destroy all the records, what makes you think the nations don't understand it now?

precepts.why:
“When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him”: that is the thousands of heaven the man waxed strong with. “Then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats”.

The sheep on his right hand hear, “Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world”. He comes with the angels of heaven, and he separates.

“And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.” Those are the thousands of heaven with him.

And the one they follow: “I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.” “He was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.” The same Word that leaped down from heaven as a fierce man of war.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth”. The four winds are the armies. The multitude gathered “from the four winds of the heaven” in Ezra is armies gathered from the four corners of the earth to subdue the man.

“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” The smith that bloweth the coals is the ones who make the bombs, the Oppenheimers. The nations think, we will fight: get the guns, get the bullets. But God says, I am not even coming with that, I am not lifting up a gun; the blast of my mouth will melt everything. I am the one who made the smith that made the weapon.

“No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn.” We don't have to worry: no weapon formed against us will work, and every tongue that rises against us in false judgment we will condemn. “This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.”

This is the peaceable multitude he calls: “a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands”, crying “Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.”

“Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God”. We are going to worship and praise our God in that day when he delivers us. Those are the peaceful ones.

The peaceable multitude sings: “I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth. Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come”. That is the praise of the people he delivers in that day.

“I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

Now you understand why they are angry, why the heathen rage: they know that one day God is going to avenge us. Their spirit will never change who they are; it is we who must change, and accept it.

sense.text:
“So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies.” We must change and accept this: you have to accept the salvation of the righteous, and you have to accept the destruction of the enemies. There is no salvation for the righteous without the destruction of our enemies.

And who are our enemies? Esau, Edom, the Caucasian, the Caucasus mountain man, the caveman. They must fall. That is the war between black and white, and that is why the heathen rage.
